options.name: current
options.rationale: the page's own Archivo grotesque, unchanged

options.name: didone-drama
options.rationale: your headings are a neutral grotesque -> a high-contrast didone adds editorial authority to the H1 numeral

options.name: warm-serif
options.rationale: softens the clinical cobalt-on-white with a humanist serif voice

options.name: complement-pop
options.rationale: your accent #2f5fe0 sits alone in blue -> a chroma-matched warm pop (H rotated ~180 deg) reserved for CTAs

options.name: deepen
options.rationale: drop the cobalt a step toward #2547b3 for a more grown-up, less saturated trust register

options.name: warm-paper
options.rationale: your ground is a cool near-white -> a warm ivory #f7f4ee reads calmer and less clinical

options.name: knife-edge
options.rationale: your 14px rounding reads friendly -> radius 0 turns the surfaces architectural and precise

options.name: soft-8
options.rationale: tighten to 8px to match the input radius for a more uniform system

options.name: current
options.rationale: the page's own filled cobalt button

options.name: square-ghost
options.rationale: your .btn-primary is a filled pill -> a hollow square with a 1px ink border reads more editorial
options.css: .btn, .btn-primary{ border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--ink-950); border:1px solid var(--ink-950) }

options.name: soft-lift
options.rationale: keep the fill but add a tinted cast so CTAs float off the near-white ground
options.css: .btn, .btn-primary{ box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(18,19,22,.06), 0 8px 24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cobalt-600) 18%, transparent) }

options.name: italic-accent
options.rationale: emphasized copy leans on the accent -> italic in var(--cobalt-600)

options.name: underline-strong
options.rationale: strong text gets a 2px accent underline offset for scannability

options.name: highlight-mark
options.rationale: marked text gets a translucent accent wash
options.css: mark{ background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--cobalt-600) 18%, transparent); color:inherit }
